main_body: Flat green grass-like ground patch (named 'sky'), a seamless terrain texture with sparse darker and lighter speckle clusters on a mid-green base
top_band: none - terrain tile, uniform mid green #5f9f48 with a periodic 1-row lighter line (#80b85a) every 16 rows from tiling speckles; no top surface/front face structure
evidence: Terrain kind: a flat ground texture, not a standing object. The column scan shows only a base green with 1-row lighter speckle rows repeating every 16 rows (tile repeat), so there is no top/front structure to judge and none is required for a ground surface. No side faces, no standing volume. Accepted as terrain.

style.evidence: The candidate has only 5 distinct colours and a median of 5 colours per tile, against 80 colours and 26 per tile for the reference grass. Flat-fill coverage is 20% where the grass reference has 0%. The surface is a mostly flat mid-green with sparse single-pixel dark and light dots repeated identically in every tile, so it shows obvious tiling and lacks the grass clumps, tufts and multi-green variation of the Beodeul grass. It reads thinner and flatter than the grass reference. The paving reference also has only 7 colours, but it is a different material with structured stones, so it does not excuse the lack of variation here. There is no outline, which is acceptable for ground.
